title: The bounds, the stall remedies, the autopilot selfcheck and the autopilot answer path are removed
goal: After the runner is gone: delete _tools/bl_bounds.py and its tests and the backlog.py bounds command (and its place in bl_cli and bl_check); keep the read-only backlog.py stalled listing of claimed items with no work commit but drop its remedy ladder, its recorded autopilot decisions and its --took path from bl_stall.py; keep selfcheck's generic host checks (claims, checkout, memory) and drop the autopilot ones; remove AUTOPILOT_REFUSED and the --by autopilot answer path from bl_authority.py, backlog.py answer and kbdecide.py (the gate classes and the rule that only the operator answers a gate stay); keep kbdecide ratify/revert/digest for operator decisions. Planted tests for what stays; removed test ids go to test_ids_dropped.txt with the reason 'autopilot retired'. Interactive session; bl_authority.py and kbdecide.py are agents-rule files.
